name: Synthetic Mission Base
description: Synthetic demonstration feature; not a real NASA science target. Flat landing-style terrain used as the start point.
geology: Flat landing-style terrain used as the start point.

name: Synthetic Western Delta
description: Synthetic demonstration feature; not a real NASA science target. Fan-shaped stack of layered sediments (synthetic stand-in for a river-delta deposit).
geology: Fan-shaped stack of layered sediments (synthetic stand-in for a river-delta deposit).
science_purpose: Check whether layers record standing water and whether they preserve chemical signs worth sampling.

name: Synthetic Crater Rim
description: Synthetic demonstration feature; not a real NASA science target. Raised, impact-modified rim with blocky material.
geology: Raised, impact-modified rim with blocky material.
science_purpose: Compare impact-altered rock with the delta layers; rim material can expose deeper strata.

name: Synthetic Lakebed
description: Synthetic demonstration feature; not a real NASA science target. Smooth basin-floor sediments (synthetic).
science_purpose: Inspect fine-grained basin sediments as a baseline for the delta comparison.

name: Synthetic Boxwork Ridge Network
description: Synthetic demonstration feature; not a real NASA science target. Network of intersecting low ridges enclosing hollows, a 'boxwork' style pattern (synthetic).
geology: Network of intersecting low ridges enclosing hollows, a 'boxwork' style pattern (synthetic).
science_purpose: Boxwork-type ridges can mark where fluids hardened cracks in the rock; the team demo uses it to show how a science goal drives route choice.
